newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: INSTANT VIEW-TMN '96 net above 7 bln esc.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-TMN '96 net above 7 bln esc.

text.p: The following are reactions to the 1996 net profit of mobile phone operator TMN-Telecomunicacoes Moveis Nacionais, a unit of Portugal Telecom (PT), which exceeded seven billion escudos.

"Portugal Telecom shares should rise today because TMN's results were better than PT had expected. The PT share price could rise by one percent. The previous estimates for PT's 1996 results will have to be altered."
"Most analysts had expected a profit of between five and 5.5 billion escudos for TMN, but as this result greatly exceeded expectations, PT should rise to 5,600 escudos.

"TMN's results are quite good. The turnover is above expectations which had been between 36 and 37 billion escudos." (The 1996 turnover of TMN exceeded 41 billion escudos, an increase of 80 percent compared with 1995).
